children: The Trust’s net assets from operations fell year over year as unrealized gains on bullion were lower, while bullion prices rose during the quarter and share creations increased outstanding shares. Net asset value per share rose 3.48%, slightly less than the 3.64% increase in the proportionate bullion price, reflecting the Sponsor’s fee.
² Reported as “Change in net assets from operations”.
: NAV increased 5.96% to $2.60B at September 30, 2026, from June 30, 2026.
: The proportionate price rose 3.64% to $206.28 per ounce from $199.04 at June 30, 2026.
: 425,000 Shares were created and 100,000 Shares were redeemed during the quarter.
: Gold represented 60.76% of net assets and silver 32.40% at September 30, 2026.
